item.text:
{
  "schema_version": "formalization-faithfulness-1",
  "role": "blind-translation",
  "dossier_sha256": "f7d452baf610bee2366aca746ae6bde9ac08af488b14d3749e132b79acef5709",
  "dependency_coverage": [
    {
      "id": "D001",
      "name": "LocalDef001",
      "meaning": "For a real square matrix A indexed by a finite type ι, there exist real numbers λ_p and an ι-indexed basis (b_p) of the real vector space ι → ℝ such that A b_p = λ_p b_p for every p.",
      "effect_on_target": "Requires a real eigenbasis for the 1 × 1 matrix [coefficient(x)] at every real x. The eigenvalues and basis may depend on x.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D002",
      "name": "LocalDef002",
      "meaning": "For every function u : ℝ → ℝ and every x,s ∈ ℝ, if u has derivative s at x, then y ↦ flux(y,u(y)) has derivative coefficient(x)s at x.",
      "effect_on_target": "The target denies the existence of any single flux satisfying this implication for all profiles, points, and derivative values.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D003",
      "name": "LocalDef003",
      "meaning": "Maps a real number a to the matrix indexed by Fin 1 in both coordinates whose sole entry is a.",
      "effect_on_target": "The matrix condition concerns exactly [coefficient(x)], acting on a one-dimensional real vector space.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D004",
      "name": "LocalDef004",
      "meaning": "Asserts continuity of the real scalar action on ℝ, namely joint continuity of real multiplication.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides structural continuity needed to interpret the derivative predicate; it adds no assumption on the coefficient or flux.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D005",
      "name": "And",
      "meaning": "Logical conjunction of two propositions.",
      "effect_on_target": "All four properties must hold for the same coefficient witness.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D006",
      "name": "ContDiff",
      "meaning": "Continuous differentiability of the specified order, defined using a Taylor-series field; its outer-top branch additionally requires analyticity of the Taylor coefficient functions.",
      "effect_on_target": "The order is WithTop.some of the top of ENat, so the coefficient is C∞ on ℝ. The outer-top analytic branch is not selected.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D007",
      "name": "DenselyNormedField.toNontriviallyNormedField",
      "meaning": "Retains the normed field structure and obtains nontriviality of the norm from a densely normed field.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the real scalar field structure for calculus without adding a variable hypothesis.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D008",
      "name": "ENat",
      "meaning": "The natural numbers with an additional greatest element ∞.",
      "effect_on_target": "Its greatest element specifies differentiation to every finite order.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D009",
      "name": "Exists",
      "meaning": "Existential quantification over the specified type.",
      "effect_on_target": "Introduces the coefficient, the pointwise eigenvalue and basis witnesses, and the flux whose existence is negated.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D010",
      "name": "Fin",
      "meaning": "Fin n is the type of natural numbers strictly less than n.",
      "effect_on_target": "Fin 1 contains exactly the index 0, so matrices and vectors have dimension one.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D011",
      "name": "Fin.fintype",
      "meaning": "The finite enumeration of all indices in Fin n.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the finite index structure for Fin 1 and its matrix sums.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D012",
      "name": "LT.lt",
      "meaning": "Projects the strict comparison relation from an LT instance.",
      "effect_on_target": "With the real instance, expresses 0 < coefficient(x).",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D013",
      "name": "Nat",
      "meaning": "The natural numbers, including zero.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the dimension 1 and the finite differentiation orders underlying ENat.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D014",
      "name": "NontriviallyNormedField.toNormedField",
      "meaning": "Projects the normed field underlying a nontrivially normed field.",
      "effect_on_target": "Preserves the real field and norm used for the self normed-space structure.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D015",
      "name": "NormedField.toNormedSpace",
      "meaning": "Views a normed field as a normed vector space over itself, with scalar multiplication given by multiplication.",
      "effect_on_target": "The coefficient's domain and codomain are the ordinary real normed vector space.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D016",
      "name": "Not",
      "meaning": "Logical negation: P → False.",
      "effect_on_target": "Rules out existence of a flux with the universal derivative property.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D017",
      "name": "OfNat.ofNat",
      "meaning": "Interprets a natural-number literal in a type using its designated instance.",
      "effect_on_target": "Interprets 0 as real zero and 1 as the natural-number dimension.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D018",
      "name": "Real",
      "meaning": "The real numbers.",
      "effect_on_target": "All coefficient values, coordinates, profile values, slopes, flux values, matrix entries, and eigenvalues are real.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D019",
      "name": "Real.denselyNormedField",
      "meaning": "The real normed field with norms occurring between any two positive bounds.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the fixed scalar-field instance used in real calculus.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D020",
      "name": "Real.instLT",
      "meaning": "The strict order on the real numbers.",
      "effect_on_target": "Makes the positivity clause ordinary strict real positivity.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D021",
      "name": "Real.instZero",
      "meaning": "The zero element of ℝ.",
      "effect_on_target": "Specifies the lower comparison value in the positivity clause.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D022",
      "name": "Real.normedAddCommGroup",
      "meaning": "The real additive commutative group with its usual norm and metric.",
      "effect_on_target": "Fixes the usual real normed structures for continuous differentiability.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D023",
      "name": "Top.top",
      "meaning": "Projects the designated greatest element of a type.",
      "effect_on_target": "Selects ∞ in ENat, before embedding it into WithTop ENat.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D024",
      "name": "WithTop.some",
      "meaning": "Embeds an element into the type obtained by adjoining a new greatest element.",
      "effect_on_target": "Distinguishes the smoothness order some(∞) from the separate outer greatest element used for the analytic branch.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D025",
      "name": "Zero.toOfNat0",
      "meaning": "Uses a type's zero element to interpret the literal 0.",
      "effect_on_target": "Ensures the positivity bound is real zero.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D026",
      "name": "instOfNatNat",
      "meaning": "Interprets each natural-number literal as that natural number itself.",
      "effect_on_target": "Makes the matrix dimension literally one.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D027",
      "name": "instTopENat",
      "meaning": "Designates the adjoined infinity as the greatest element of ENat = WithTop Nat.",
      "effect_on_target": "Together with WithTop.some, sets the coefficient's differentiability order to C∞.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D028",
      "name": "Algebra.id",
      "meaning": "The algebra of a commutative semiring over itself, with identity algebra map and multiplication as scalar action.",
      "effect_on_target": "Identifies the relevant real self-action with ordinary real multiplication.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D029",
      "name": "Algebra.toSMul",
      "meaning": "Projects the scalar action of an algebra.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies real scalar multiplication used in the eigenvector equations.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D030",
      "name": "CommRing.toNonUnitalCommRing",
      "meaning": "Forgets the designated multiplicative unit while retaining a commutative ring's additive and multiplicative operations.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides inherited real ring structure for matrix operations without changing those operations.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D031",
      "name": "CommSemiring.toSemiring",
      "meaning": "Forgets the commutativity requirement from a commutative semiring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the semiring structure needed for real modules and bases.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D032",
      "name": "DFunLike.coe",
      "meaning": "Extracts the underlying function from a function-like object.",
      "effect_on_target": "Allows evaluation of a basis at an index to obtain its basis vector.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D033",
      "name": "Eq",
      "meaning": "Equality of two objects of the same type.",
      "effect_on_target": "Requires exact vector equality A b_p = λ_p b_p, not an approximation.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D034",
      "name": "Fintype",
      "meaning": "A finite enumeration containing every element of a type.",
      "effect_on_target": "Makes matrix-vector sums finite; the target uses the nonempty singleton Fin 1.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D035",
      "name": "Function.hasSMul",
      "meaning": "Scalar multiplication on function spaces induced pointwise from scalar multiplication on their values.",
      "effect_on_target": "The scalar multiple of an eigenvector is computed coordinatewise.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D036",
      "name": "HMul.hMul",
      "meaning": "Projects the multiplication operation from a heterogeneous multiplication instance.",
      "effect_on_target": "Here it denotes ordinary multiplication coefficient(x) · slope in ℝ.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D037",
      "name": "HSMul.hSMul",
      "meaning": "Projects the scalar action from a heterogeneous scalar multiplication instance.",
      "effect_on_target": "Denotes multiplication of a real vector by its real eigenvalue.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D038",
      "name": "HasDerivAt",
      "meaning": "The function has the specified derivative at the specified point, using the neighborhood filter at that point with the base point fixed.",
      "effect_on_target": "Uses ordinary two-sided real derivatives at x, requiring only differentiability of the profile at x and requiring existence and the stated value of the composite derivative.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D039",
      "name": "Matrix",
      "meaning": "A matrix with row type m, column type n, and entries in α is a function m → n → α.",
      "effect_on_target": "The coefficient matrix has exactly one real entry, indexed by (0,0).",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D040",
      "name": "Matrix.mulVec",
      "meaning": "Matrix-vector multiplication: (Mv)(i) = Σ_j M(i,j)v(j).",
      "effect_on_target": "For the target's singleton index, the eigenvector equation is coefficient(x)b_p(0) = λ_p b_p(0).",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D041",
      "name": "Module.Basis",
      "meaning": "An indexed linear basis of a module, giving unique finite linear-coordinate representations.",
      "effect_on_target": "The eigenvectors must form a basis of Fin 1 → ℝ; a zero vector alone cannot satisfy this requirement.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D042",
      "name": "Module.Basis.instFunLike",
      "meaning": "Evaluates a basis at index i by applying its inverse coordinate representation to the coordinate vector with entry 1 at i and 0 elsewhere.",
      "effect_on_target": "Identifies b_p in each eigenvector equation as the actual pth basis vector.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D043",
      "name": "NonUnitalCommRing.toNonUnitalNonAssocCommRing",
      "meaning": "Forgets the associativity requirement while retaining the operations of a nonunital commutative ring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Transports unchanged real arithmetic toward the weaker structure required for matrix multiplication.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D044",
      "name": "NonUnitalNonAssocCommRing.toNonUnitalNonAssocRing",
      "meaning": "Forgets multiplicative commutativity while retaining the underlying nonunital nonassociative ring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies inherited real operations to matrix-vector multiplication.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D045",
      "name": "NonUnitalNonAssocRing.toNonUnitalNonAssocSemiring",
      "meaning": "Retains addition, multiplication, zero, and distributivity while forgetting additive inverses as required structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the precise algebraic structure used by Matrix.mulVec, with ordinary real operations.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D046",
      "name": "NonUnitalSeminormedCommRing.toNonUnitalSeminormedRing",
      "meaning": "Forgets multiplicative commutativity from a nonunital seminormed commutative ring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Preserves the real seminorm and topology along an instance conversion.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D047",
      "name": "NonUnitalSeminormedRing.toSeminormedAddCommGroup",
      "meaning": "Extracts the additive commutative group, seminorm, and pseudometric of a nonunital seminormed ring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the inherited real additive and metric structure for calculus-related modules.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D048",
      "name": "NormedCommRing.toSeminormedCommRing",
      "meaning": "Views a normed commutative ring as a seminormed commutative ring with the same operations and norm.",
      "effect_on_target": "Leaves the real arithmetic and metric unchanged in the structural instance chain.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D049",
      "name": "NormedSpace.toModule",
      "meaning": "Extracts the module structure of a normed space.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the real vector-space action underlying derivatives and linear algebra.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D050",
      "name": "Pi.Function.module",
      "meaning": "The module structure on I → β obtained by pointwise operations from a module β over α.",
      "effect_on_target": "Makes Fin 1 → ℝ the usual one-dimensional real vector space for the eigenbasis.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D051",
      "name": "Pi.addCommMonoid",
      "meaning": "The additive commutative monoid structure on a function space, defined pointwise.",
      "effect_on_target": "Vector addition and zero in the eigenbasis space are coordinatewise.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D052",
      "name": "PseudoMetricSpace.toUniformSpace",
      "meaning": "Extracts the uniform structure associated with a pseudometric space.",
      "effect_on_target": "Connects the ordinary real distance to the topology used in derivative predicates.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D053",
      "name": "Real.commRing",
      "meaning": "The commutative ring structure given by ordinary real arithmetic.",
      "effect_on_target": "Fixes the addition, multiplication, and scalar arithmetic used in the matrix condition.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D054",
      "name": "Real.instAddCommGroup",
      "meaning": "The inherited additive commutative group of the real numbers.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the real additive structure required for derivatives and normed spaces.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D055",
      "name": "Real.instAddCommMonoid",
      "meaning": "The inherited additive commutative monoid of the real numbers.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides real addition and zero for the coordinate vector space and basis.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D056",
      "name": "Real.instCommSemiring",
      "meaning": "The inherited commutative semiring structure of the real numbers.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports the real identity algebra and its scalar action.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D057",
      "name": "Real.instMul",
      "meaning": "Ordinary multiplication of real numbers.",
      "effect_on_target": "Determines both coefficient(x) · slope and the real multiplication underlying scalar actions.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D058",
      "name": "Real.normedCommRing",
      "meaning": "The real commutative ring equipped with its usual norm and metric.",
      "effect_on_target": "Ensures the algebraic and topological structures in the dependency chain are the standard compatible real ones.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D059",
      "name": "Real.normedField",
      "meaning": "The real field equipped with the absolute-value norm and usual metric.",
      "effect_on_target": "Fixes the scalar field and norm for differentiability and the real self-module.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D060",
      "name": "Real.pseudoMetricSpace",
      "meaning": "The pseudometric structure on ℝ with distance d(x,y) = |x-y|.",
      "effect_on_target": "The neighborhood and continuity notions are those of the usual real topology.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D061",
      "name": "Real.semiring",
      "meaning": "The inherited semiring structure of real addition and multiplication.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the scalar semiring used to form real bases and modules.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D062",
      "name": "SeminormedCommRing.toNonUnitalSeminormedCommRing",
      "meaning": "Forgets the designated unit while preserving a seminormed commutative ring's operations, norm, and pseudometric.",
      "effect_on_target": "Preserves the standard real structures along the instance path for calculus.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D063",
      "name": "Semiring.toModule",
      "meaning": "Views a semiring as a module over itself by left multiplication.",
      "effect_on_target": "Real scalar multiplication on ℝ is ordinary multiplication.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D064",
      "name": "UniformSpace.toTopologicalSpace",
      "meaning": "Extracts the topology underlying a uniform space.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the usual topology on the real codomain in the derivative predicate.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D065",
      "name": "instHMul",
      "meaning": "Uses a type's multiplication as heterogeneous multiplication with the same input and output type.",
      "effect_on_target": "The product in the derivative conclusion is the real product coefficient(x) · slope.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D066",
      "name": "instHSMul",
      "meaning": "Uses an existing scalar action as a heterogeneous scalar action with unchanged vector type.",
      "effect_on_target": "The eigenvalue acts on a basis vector through the standard pointwise real scalar action.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D067",
      "name": "ContinuousSMul",
      "meaning": "Joint continuity of the map (r,v) ↦ r • v for the specified scalar and vector topologies.",
      "effect_on_target": "Its real instance supports HasDerivAt; it imposes no separate regularity condition on a proposed flux.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D068",
      "name": "NormedField.toNormedCommRing",
      "meaning": "Extracts a normed commutative ring from a normed field with the same norm, metric, and arithmetic.",
      "effect_on_target": "Keeps real calculus and scalar multiplication based on the same standard structures.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D069",
      "name": "SeminormedCommRing.toSeminormedRing",
      "meaning": "Forgets multiplicative commutativity from a seminormed commutative ring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Preserves the norm and topology used in the continuous scalar-action instance.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D070",
      "name": "SeminormedRing.toPseudoMetricSpace",
      "meaning": "Extracts the pseudometric of a seminormed ring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the metric-derived topology for the real scalar-action and derivative structures.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D071",
      "name": "instSMulOfMul",
      "meaning": "Defines scalar multiplication of a type on itself by its multiplication: r • v = rv.",
      "effect_on_target": "Confirms that real self-scaling in the dependency chain is ordinary real multiplication.",
      "status": "understood"
    }
  ],
  "translation": {
    "binders": [
      "There exists a single coefficient a : ℝ → ℝ.",
      "The positivity and matrix clauses each quantify over every x ∈ ℝ.",
      "For each x, the matrix clause existentially quantifies λ : Fin 1 → ℝ and a basis b indexed by Fin 1 of the real vector space Fin 1 → ℝ, then universally quantifies p ∈ Fin 1. These witnesses may depend on x and a.",
      "For the selected a, there does not exist F : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ satisfying the specified flux property.",
      "Inside that property, one universally quantifies a profile u : ℝ → ℝ, a point x ∈ ℝ, and a slope s ∈ ℝ. A candidate F must work simultaneously for every such choice."
    ],
    "hypotheses": [
      "There are no external hypotheses or universally quantified coefficient parameters.",
      "The flux property is conditional on u having derivative s at x; no global regularity assumption on u is imposed."
    ],
    "conclusions": [
      "The coefficient a is infinitely continuously differentiable on all of ℝ.",
      "For every x ∈ ℝ, a(x) > 0.",
      "For every x ∈ ℝ, the real matrix A_x = [a(x)] has a real eigenbasis: there exist λ and b as specified such that A_x b_p = λ_p b_p for every p ∈ Fin 1.",
      "There is no function F : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ such that, for every u : ℝ → ℝ and every x,s ∈ ℝ, u'(x) = s in the sense of existence of the derivative implies that y ↦ F(y,u(y)) has derivative a(x)s at x."
    ],
    "mathematical_definitions": [
      "Fin 1 = {0}; the vector space Fin 1 → ℝ has dimension one.",
      "A_x(i,j) = a(x) for the sole pair i = j = 0, and (A_x v)(0) = a(x)v(0).",
      "A real eigenbasis is a linearly independent spanning family of real vectors satisfying the displayed eigenvector equations; it is not required to be orthonormal.",
      "The differentiability order is some(∞) in WithTop ENat, expressing C∞ regularity rather than selection of the separate analytic branch.",
      "HasDerivAt g t x means that the ordinary two-sided derivative of g at x exists and equals t.",
      "The flux property differentiates the full composition y ↦ F(y,u(y)), including the variation of F's first argument."
    ],
    "proposition_plain_english": "There exists a smooth function a : ℝ → ℝ that is strictly positive everywhere and whose associated 1 × 1 matrix [a(x)] admits a real eigenbasis at every real x, but for which no single function F : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ has the following property: for every real-valued profile u on ℝ, at every point x where u has derivative s, the function y ↦ F(y,u(y)) has derivative a(x)s at x."
  },
  "restrictions_and_vacuity_risks": [
    "The coefficient, profiles, and flux are defined globally on real domains; there is no restricted interval, boundary, or exceptional set of points.",
    "The matrix dimension is fixed at one. Every real 1 × 1 matrix has a real eigenbasis, so this clause imposes no additional restriction on a.",
    "Fin 1 is nonempty, and a basis vector is nonzero; the eigenbasis clause is not satisfied by an empty family or by choosing zero eigenvectors.",
    "Eigenvalue and basis witnesses are pointwise. Their continuity, smoothness, normalization, and uniform bounds are not required.",
    "Strict positivity is pointwise; no positive uniform lower bound or upper bound is specified.",
    "Profiles need only be differentiable at the tested point. For a profile, point, and slope not satisfying the derivative premise, the implication imposes no requirement.",
    "The derivative premise is not universally vacuous: affine profiles realize every prescribed value and slope at every point.",
    "The excluded flux ranges over all functions of two real arguments, without a separately imposed continuity or differentiability class. The required composite derivatives are part of the excluded property itself.",
    "A flux cannot be chosen separately for each profile or point: it must satisfy the universal property for the fixed coefficient.",
    "The statement supplies no explicit coefficient formula and does not explicitly assert nonconstancy. Nonconstancy follows from the nonexistence clause, since a constant coefficient c admits F(x,z) = cz.",
    "No differential equation, time variable, solution class, integral conservation statement, weak formulation, or boundary condition is encoded."
  ],
  "ambiguities": []
}
